shots.description: Golden hour. Rook Calloway stands at the Marina, job one on the tracker, the harbor stretching east.
shots.title: Start — Rook on foot at the Marina

shots.description: Rook driving a stolen sedan down the grid as the light turns gold, minimap and HUD live.
shots.title: Drive — carving through the city at dusk

shots.description: Night falling, wanted level two, two harbor police units on Rook's tail with sirens and light bars.
shots.title: Chase — two stars, police closing in

shots.description: All five jobs complete. Rook at the extraction point in the boat, night over the harbor, $5750 banked.
shots.title: Complete — the Sunset Getaway, all jobs done
